title: ITV / Typography guidance interface
slide_intent: Pair named type roles with examples so designers can compare function and expression, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A laptop displays a guideline page with a type hierarchy table on the left and yellow-backed copy examples on the right. The screen includes Headline, Emphasis and Supporting labels.
practical_value: Pair named type roles with examples so designers can compare function and expression.

content_islands.name: Device
content_islands.spec: The laptop presents the guidance in use.

content_islands.name: Examples
content_islands.spec: Right-side typography illustrates the roles in compositions.
